description: external-windows-wma10pro-cbr-stereo-44k-128.wma written without the length prefix by make_wma_pro_no_length_prefix.py: the same frames, joined without their prefixes and cut into packets again, and the length prefix bit of the decode flags cleared. Not an encoder's output and never decoded by Windows; it holds the frames of Media Foundation's transcoder (derived.source) in the layout of a writer without the prefix, so the frames that start in the last packet, which a decoder reads, are covered.
note: Written by the script from the committed source; running it again gives the same bytes. The File Properties object's file ID and creation date are the source's.

derived.note: Not an encoder's output: the source's frames in another layout.
